title.value: Continual Learning via Local Module Composition
title.justification: The title is prominently displayed at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Continual Learning via Local Module Composition

analysis.description: This paper introduces Local Module Composition (LMC), an approach to modular continual learning (CL) where each module dynamically estimates its relevance to the input, enabling dynamic layer-wise module composition based on local relevance scores. This method addresses challenges in CL such as catastrophic forgetting and forward/backward transfer across tasks, and it demonstrates effectiveness in various CL settings using multiple benchmarks and datasets.

type.justification: The paper presents empirical studies and comparisons using benchmarks and datasets to evaluate the effectiveness of Local Module Composition (LMC).
type.quote: We demonstrate that agnosticity to task identities (IDs) arises from...making LMC applicable to more CL settings compared to previous works. In addition, LMC also tracks statistics about the input distribution and adds new modules when outlier samples are detected.

name.justification: The core focus of the paper is on continual learning, particularly addressing challenges like catastrophic forgetting and task transfer without requiring task identities.
name.quote: Modularity is a compelling solution to continual learning (CL), the problem of modeling sequences of related tasks.

name.justification: The paper extensively discusses modular learning as a way to manage continual learning tasks through the use of specialized modules.
name.quote: Modular learning aims at balancing transfer and forgetting by learning a set of specialized modules that can be recomposed to solve (new) tasks while only updating a subset of relevant modules or adding new modules.

name.justification: The paper evaluates LMC using the Continual Transfer Learning (CTrL) benchmark, which focuses on evaluating transfer and forgetting in continual learning.
name.quote: We study...using the Continual Transfer Learning (CTrL) benchmark, designed to evaluate transfer and forgetting in CL.

name.justification: The paper introduces Local Module Composition (LMC) as a contribution for addressing continual learning challenges.
name.quote: In a set of studies, we explore the performance and versatility of our local structural approach, which we call Local Module Composer (LMC).
